entries.description:
Role Overview
We are looking for motivated Java Developers with 0–4 years of experience to join our growing team. This role is ideal for fresh graduates eager to start their careers or early professionals seeking to expand their expertise in enterprise-level software development.

Key Responsibilities
Java application development: Design, develop, and maintain applications using Java.

Code debugging: Identify and resolve technical issues efficiently.

Database integration: Work with SQL and relational databases.

API development: Build and consume RESTful services.

Team collaboration: Partner with QA, DevOps, and product teams.

📚 Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Core Java (OOP, collections, exception handling).

Familiarity with Spring Framework or similar.

Understanding of SQL/databases.

Exposure to REST APIs.

Good problem-solving and communication skills.

🌟 Preferred Skills
Experience with Microservices.

Knowledge of Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Familiarity with Version control tools like Git.

🎓 Eligibility
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.

Fresh graduates and candidates with up to 4 years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
